name: Write On-Start Dispatcher
description: Writes the on_start_container dispatcher into the proxvex volume. Proxmox invokes it on every container start and it runs all drop-ins in /etc/proxvex/on_start.d/. Addon-free counterpart of 166 for applications that need the dispatcher without addon hooks.

commands.description: Write on_start_container dispatcher to host-side proxvex volume
